evals.prompt: /save-zk — Note Key confirmed: ACME-100. Session explored multi-service auth architecture.
evals.expected_output: Creates Session Note for ACME-100 with Living Head (BLUF, executive summary, findings table), issue tag, optional d2/mermaid fence, top-level Deep Context details, no Update section, Daily back-link; no Task Matrix; no assets/base64.

assertions.description: New Session Note with Living Head; no ## Update section
Contains BLUF blockquote with current truth
Key Findings is a markdown table (Category | Finding | Impact/Next)
Frontmatter tags include acme-100 (or ACME-100 normalized)
If structure present: fenced d2 or mermaid; never base64 or asset files
Create includes top-level Deep Context <details>
No Task Matrix section
Attempts Daily Note back-link after Session Note write

evals.prompt: save-zk — same key ACME-100; new session delta only.
evals.expected_output: Living Head replaced; prior body/Update preserved; new Update delta only; create details untouched; Daily back-link; most-recent if multi-match.

assertions.description: BLUF/findings reflect new session truth
Frozen create Deep Context and prior Update bodies unchanged
Exactly one new ## Update: dated section with delta only (not full findings table)
Daily back-link attempted
If multiple tagged notes, updates most recently modified

evals.prompt: /save-zk — Note Key ACME-200; session has latency metrics.
evals.expected_output: Metric table in Visual; BLUF mentions outcome; no required visualize CLI.

assertions.description: Visual section includes a metrics markdown table
BLUF mentions measured outcome or status
Does not require vl2svg/visualize CLI to complete

assertions.description: Note Key/title uses user slug, not a fabricated tracker id
Does not add a fake Jira/GitHub issue tag
Full Living Head create shape with BLUF and findings table
